title: CPAP respiratory pressure measurements
deterministic_selection_rule: All 60 PQ_rawData raw trial CSVs, all source Code files, LICENSE.txt, README.txt and subject-info.csv; EIT/HRM and processed datasets excluded.

measurement_dates.description: PhysioNet version 1.0.0 published 2024-03-20; StartTime fields preserve per-trial acquisition timestamps.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Raw sensor/ADC exports require the source calibration code to interpret pressure/flow. Separate source processed tables, EIT and HRM are deliberately excluded. No calibration was applied during collection.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Source Code documents sensor conversions and experimental protocols. PEEP settings and maneuver names are not independent subjects. Resistance/compliance may not both be identifiable without defensible flow reconstruction and timing.
